values.note: Single site $22 (Loops A & B), single with electric $30 (Loop C); double sites $35, double electric $52 (FS page also lists Loop C double at $50); walk-to tent $17/$28; group tent $65. Two vehicles per single site; a daily fee for extra vehicles.

values.note: 38 RV sites: 13 electric in Loop C (two of them doubles) and 25 non-electric in Loops A and B, besides 40 walk-to tent sites and 3 group tent sites. Non-electric spurs take 25 ft, electric 35-45 ft; two electric sites are pull-through (the catalog lists one, site 038, at 90 ft). Paved spurs.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232095 (site types, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232095 ('11 standard camping units with electric hookups, 2 double camping units with electric hookups, 23 standard camping units without electric, 2 double camping units without electric, 40 walk-in camp sites and 3 group tent sites ... paved spurs'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Four flush restrooms with showers and three vault restrooms; one RV dump station beside the host site. Firewood sold on site; an amphitheater.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232095 ('two four-toilet vault restrooms, one double-toilet vault restroom, and four multiple-toilet flush restrooms with showers', 'one recreation vehicle dump station', 'drinking water') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/seneca-shadows-campground ('Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The permit holder must operate the campground 'from the second Friday night in April through the last Saturday night in October'; the average season has been 'approximately April 10th through Oct 31st'.

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232095 (Overview: 'The average operation and maintenance season for Seneca Shadows Campground has been from approximately April 10th through Oct 31st. At a minimum, the Forest Service (FS) will expect the permit Holder to fully operate the campground from the second Friday night in April through the last Saturday night in October'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov at least 4 days ahead, up to 6 months ahead for standard sites (12 for group sites, per the Forest Service; recreation.gov's rule record says 11 months). 13 of the RV sites are first-come. Weekends 2 nights, holiday weekends 3. Concession-run (American Land & Leisure).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/seneca-shadows-campground ('Reservations must be made 4 days ahead of arrival and can be made up to 6 months in advance for standard sites or 12 months in advance for group sites', 'This campground has first-come, first-served sites') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232095 (rules: minWeekendStay 2 'Ignore Holidays', minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 4 days, reservationWindow 11 Months) + campsite catalog (13 RV sites not reservable), read 2026-10-21
